001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.command;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;

011import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
012
013import java.util.Collections;
014import java.util.HashMap;
015import java.util.List;
016import java.util.Map;
017import java.util.StringJoiner;
018import java.util.UUID;

021/**
022 * The command handler that processing sub commands under QS main command
023 *
024 * @param <T> The required sender class you want, must is the subtype of {@link CommandSender}
025 */
026public interface CommandHandler<T extends CommandSender> {
027
028  /** Resolves an optional shop id argument, otherwise the shop the player is looking at. */
029  @Nullable
030  default Shop findShop(final T sender, final CommandParser parser, final int idIndex) {
031
032    if(parser.getArgs().size() > idIndex) {
033      try {
034        return QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().getShop(Long.parseLong(parser.getArgs().get(idIndex)));
035      } catch(final NumberFormatException ignored) {
036        // Fall back to the shop in the player's line of sight.
037      }
038    }
039    return getLookingShop(sender);
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Getting the player now looking shop
044   *
045   * @return The shop that player looking or null if not found
046   *
047   * @throws IllegalStateException if sender is not player
048   */
049  @Nullable
050  default Shop getLookingShop(final T sender) throws IllegalStateException {
051
052    if(sender instanceof Player player) {
053      final BlockIterator bIt = new BlockIterator(player, 10);
054      while(bIt.hasNext()) {
055        final Block b = bIt.next();
056        final Shop shop = QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().getShop(b.getLocation());
057        if(shop == null) {
058          continue;
059        }
060        return shop;
061      }
062      return null;
063    }
064    throw new IllegalStateException("Sender is not player");
065  }
066
067  default @NotNull CompletableFuture<@NotNull List<Shop>> getTaggedShops(final T sender, @NotNull final String tag) {
068
069    if(sender instanceof Player player) {
070      final UUID tagger = player.getUniqueId();
071      return QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().queryTaggedShops(tagger, tag);
072    }
073    throw new IllegalStateException("Sender is not player");
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Getting the shops by ids
078   *
079   * @param ids The shop ids
080   *
081   * @return The shops
082   */
083  @Nullable
084  default Map<Long, Shop> getShopsByIds(@NotNull final List<Long> ids) {
085
086    final Map<Long, Shop> shops = new HashMap<>();
087    for(final Long id : ids) {
088      shops.put(id, QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getShopManager().getShop(id));
089    }
090    return shops;
091  }
092
093  default void onCommand_Internal(final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final String[] cmdArg) {
094
095    final StringJoiner joiner = new StringJoiner(" ");
096    for(final String s : cmdArg) {
097      joiner.add(s);
098    }
099
100    final CommandParser parser = new CommandParser(joiner.toString(), true);
101    try {
102      onCommand(sender, commandLabel, parser);
103    } catch(NotImplementedException e) {
104      try {
105        onCommand(sender, commandLabel, parser.getArgs().toArray(new String[0]));
106      } catch(NotImplementedException ignored) {
107
108      }
109    }
110  }
111
112  /**
113   * Calling while command executed by specified sender
114   *
115   * @param sender       The command sender but will automatically convert to specified instance
116   * @param commandLabel The command prefix (/quickshop = qs, /shop = shop)
117   * @param parser       The command parser which include arguments and colon arguments
118   */
119  default void onCommand(final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final CommandParser parser) {
120
121    throw new NotImplementedException("This method should be correctly implemented.");
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * Calling while command executed by specified sender
126   *
127   * @param sender       The command sender but will automatically convert to specified instance
128   * @param commandLabel The command prefix (/quickshop = qs, /shop = shop)
129   * @param cmdArgs      The command arguments
130   *
131   * @deprecated This method is deprecated, please use {@link #onCommand(T, String, CommandParser)}
132   * instead.
133   */
134  @Deprecated(since = "4.2.0.0")
135  default void onCommand(final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final String[] cmdArgs) {
136
137    throw new NotImplementedException("This method is deprecated, please use onCommand(T sender, @NotNull String commandLabel, @NotNull CommandParser parser) instead.");
138  }
139
140  @Nullable
141  default List<String> onTabComplete_Internal(@NotNull final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final String[] cmdArg) {
142
143    final StringJoiner joiner = new StringJoiner(" ");
144    for(final String s : cmdArg) {
145      joiner.add(s);
146    }
147    final CommandParser parser = new CommandParser(joiner.toString(), false);
148    try {
149      return onTabComplete(sender, commandLabel, parser);
150    } catch(NotImplementedException e) {
151      try {
152        return onTabComplete(sender, commandLabel, parser.getArgs().toArray(new String[0]));
153      } catch(NotImplementedException ignored) {
154        return Collections.emptyList();
155      }
156    }
157  }
158
159  /**
160   * Calling while sender trying to tab-complete
161   *
162   * @param sender       The command sender but will automatically convert to specified instance
163   * @param commandLabel The command prefix (/quickshop = qs, /shop = shop)
164   * @param parser       The command parser which include arguments and colon arguments
165   *
166   * @return Candidate list
167   */
168  @Nullable
169  default List<String> onTabComplete(@NotNull final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final CommandParser parser) {
170
171    throw new NotImplementedException("This method should be correctly implemented.");
172  }
173
174  /**
175   * Calling while sender trying to tab-complete
176   *
177   * @param sender       The command sender but will automatically convert to specified instance
178   * @param commandLabel The command prefix (/quickshop = qs, /shop = shop)
179   * @param cmdArgs      The command arguments
180   *
181   * @return Candidate list
182   *
183   * @deprecated This method is deprecated, please use
184   * {@link #onTabComplete(T, String, CommandParser)} instead.
185   */
186  @Deprecated(since = "4.2.0.0")
187  default List<String> onTabComplete(@NotNull final T sender, @NotNull final String commandLabel, @NotNull final String[] cmdArgs) {
188
189    throw new NotImplementedException("This method is deprecated, please use onTabComplete(T sender, @NotNull String commandLabel, @NotNull CommandParser parser) instead.");
190  }
191}
